decisions.reason: The DPA management tool costs little to maintain, fits the firm's compliance direction, and has positive agency feedback, so keeping the option open is still worthwhile.
The flagship management platform is the core of the agency-focused strategy, and nothing signals that its value will fail to materialize, so the firm will keep committing to it.

The configurable managed plan runs on owned infrastructure at low marginal cost, but with no visible results its value is still unresolved, so the option stays open, though it is somewhat at risk of being folded into other plans.
Extended PHP security support is cheap to provide and meets real demand from agencies on legacy projects, though it may be time-limited by nature as PHP versions age out.
